question: Can buying property lead to UAE residency?
answer: Property investment can qualify a buyer for a UAE residence visa. As of 2026, sole owners of a completed residential property of any value can apply for a renewable 2-year investor visa (Dubai removed the previous AED 750,000 minimum for single owners; co-owners each need a share of at least AED 400,000). A property investment of AED 2 million or more can instead support a 10-year Golden Visa. Thresholds, eligible property types and required documentation are set by federal authorities and can change, so always confirm the current criteria with an immigration advisor or the relevant authority before relying on this for a decision.
